drums.tags: Industrial stomp-clap percussion track. The arrangement is built on a heavy, distorted kick drum hitting on every beat, layered with a metallic, resonant snare-like clap on beats two and four. A syncopated rhythmic pattern is created by a high-pitched, metallic 'tink' sound and a lower-frequency wooden thud. The tempo is 120 BPM in 4/4 time. The track features a prominent, distorted synth bass that follows a rhythmic ostinato, providing a gritty, overdriven texture. Mid-way through, a filtered, resonant synth sweep rises in pitch, accompanied by an increase in the density of the metallic percussion hits. The piece concludes with a sudden cut to a decaying reverb tail of the final kick and metallic strike.
